description: Action for Health is a public Nova Scotia table of aggregated health-service reporting measures. The provider says that it combines hospital inpatient, emergency, surgical, continuing-care and emergency-health-service sources, and that it excludes personally identifying patient information. Its published fields are Zone, Hospital, Type, Date, Measure Name, Actual and CTAS. The provider labels the geographic region Nova Scotia, gives monthly values, describes a quarterly refresh frequency and states coverage from April 2021 through the third quarter of fiscal 2023-2024. The public Socrata page and metadata API identify the table; the official metadata states the Nova Scotia Open Government Licence and no access charge. A modeller could use hospital demand and occupancy series to calibrate or test healthcare-capacity scenarios, after selecting compatible measures and time periods. The provider warns that the table is supplied as is. A linked independent SQL analysis reports repeated proposed-grain combinations with conflicting values, so row grain and emergency-visit boundary months require checks before aggregation. The table rows, official data-dictionary attachment and source-system definitions were not downloaded or independently checked.
